figurative_meaning_en: Consuming light snacks or refreshments other than main meals like rice and curry
example_sentences_in_bangla: খাবার শেষ করে সে জলপান করল।
পার্টিতে জলপানের জন্য চিড়া-দই রাখা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After the meal, he had some refreshments.
Snacks like puffed rice and yogurt were served as light fare at the party.
note: Refers to traditional Bengali practice of light eating between meals
